## Description {#details}

<p>This file remove instruction after trap.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput">llvm.trap</span> will be convert as <span class="doxyComputerOutput">unreachable</span> which is terminator. <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/instruction">Instruction</a> after terminator will cause validation failed.</p>
